title_zh: Jev-Mobile：以 Jev 作为移动端 GUI 智能体的执行器
one_line: A VLM sets local goals while a typed decision model executes several accessibility-tree actions per goal; near-baseline AndroidWorld success with lower latency and cost.
one_line_zh: VLM低频设定局部目标，类型化决策模型在无障碍树候选中连续执行多步，AndroidWorld成功率接近基线且时延与成本更低。

online_eval.quote: On the full AndroidWorld task suite, Jev-Mobile achieves 79% task success, compared with 78% for SeeAct-V and 84% for a Step-wise VLM baseline.

strong_baselines.quote: The systems differ in observation and action interfaces, and SeeAct-V’s grounder is not its original UGround configuration.

budget_matched.quote: Wall time, actions, calls, waits, and retries share an episode budget; invalid outputs, stale IDs, overflows, and API errors remain in the event ledger.

cost_reported.quote: Mean model API cost per successful trajectory is $0.072744 for Jev-Mobile, compared with $0.193207 and $0.273694, respectively.

component_ablation.quote: We compare with two baselines, Step-wise VLM and SeeAct-V, but have not tested the Jev-Mobile workflow with Jev replaced by a small VLM

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate on the full AndroidWorld task suite using its task initialization and terminal evaluators

F4.quote: We compare with two baselines, Step-wise VLM and SeeAct-V, but have not tested the Jev-Mobile workflow with Jev replaced by a small VLM

AP9.quote: have not tested the Jev-Mobile workflow with Jev replaced by a small VLM; that comparison would clarify whether the observed behavior depends on typed decision-model execution or on the delegated workflow more generally

AP14.quote: If a visual target has no executable tree candidate, the VLM can reinterpret the goal but this first version still may not reach the target: it has no coordinate-producing visual fallback.

title_zh: 从点击到跳转：用应用原生深度链接增强移动端 GUI 智能体
one_line: Adds verified app deeplinks as tool actions beside GUI actions, trained by hybrid SFT and online RL; higher MobileWorld and real-device success with fewer steps.
one_line_zh: 将经真机验证的应用深度链接作为工具动作与GUI操作混合，经SFT与在线RL训练，在MobileWorld及真机上成功率更高、步数更少。

online_eval.quote: MobileWorld provides a simulated Android environment with 13 built-in applications, where we evaluate all 117 tasks.

held_out_env.quote: We synthesize training trajectories from tasks constructed around the mined catalog (Figure 2 (b)).

variance.quote: We evaluate each MobileWorld task three times per setting and compute success rate over all 351 task executions.

strong_baselines.quote: The two trained agents use paired trajectories from the same tasks and otherwise follow identical training configurations; they differ only in whether deeplink actions and their associated feedback are available.

budget_matched.quote: The two trained agents use paired trajectories from the same tasks and otherwise follow identical training configurations

cost_reported.quote: It reduces average steps across all trajectories by 15.26–21.30%, with shorter successful trajectories at every scale.

component_ablation.quote: Online reinforcement learning increases success rate from 57.83% to 60.11%, while reducing the average number of steps across all trajectories from 22.52 to 20.91.

evidence_level.quote: We deploy the complete pipeline on MobileWorld-Real to verify whether hybrid interaction generalizes to commercial applications running on physical devices.

S5.quote: At inference, we retrieve up to 10 candidate deeplinks from the catalog based on the current task and provide them to GUI-Hopper.

S6.quote: Across all three model scales, GUI-Hopper with access to deeplinks consistently achieves higher success rates than the GUI-only agent using GUI actions alone.

AP5.quote: Across the 26 commercial applications selected for MobileWorld-Real evaluation, the resulting catalog contains 1,251 verified entries.

title_zh: REBASE：跨应用更新的GUI智能体端云经验一致性
one_line: Keeps cached on-device action-path experience coherent after app updates via cloud replay, step verification and staged-evidence patches; restores success at far lower bytes.
one_line_zh: 应用更新后通过云端回放、端侧逐步校验与分级证据补丁保持端云经验一致，以极少流量恢复成功率。

online_eval.quote: each task is a parameterized goal whose evaluator reads the app state, as in AndroidWorld [ 46 ] , so no model judges success.

held_out_env.quote: Nine version pairs, six obtainable by the cloud and three blind, each with five tasks, produce 45 evaluation units.

variance.quote: We report means across units with standard deviations across seeds, and for T_{r} the median over all unit–seed pairs.

strong_baselines.quote: Screenshot-to-cloud, a MAI-UI-style takeover baseline [ 3 ] , sends a screenshot after a mismatch and transfers the remaining episode to the cloud, whereas CoMIC-style trajectory upload [ 14 ] sends the complete episode and receives a patch.

budget_matched.quote: Each method, or arm , runs every unit for K=5 post-update episodes under three seeds. An episode ends upon success, after 30 steps, or after six minutes

cost_reported.quote: REBASE uses 708 \times fewer bytes and 47.3 \times fewer cloud calls than this baseline, and 215 \times fewer bytes than trajectory upload.

component_ablation.quote: Without the failure clock (X2), success falls to 56.4% from 88.0% on blind pairs and to 92.7% from 96.7% on cloud-visible pairs.

evidence_level.quote: Both control Android 13 AndroidWorld environments [ 46 ] hosted on a Jetson AGX Thor gateway.

S1.quote: We test nine AndroidWorld apps; v is the version AndroidWorld pins, and v^{\prime} is the next F-Droid Archive release that changes an accessibility tree along a recorded path.

S5.quote: Relative to stale experience, REBASE raises Succ@ K by 56.1 points (95% confidence interval: [51.6, 60.6]) and matches fresh experience recorded on the new version

title_zh: PastForward：通过计算经验复用加速端侧GUI智能体
one_line: Reuses past output token sequences as verified speculative proposals, predicted next screens for early inference, and carried KV state; 1.4-2.4x faster steps, same AndroidWorld success.
one_line_zh: 复用历史输出token序列做可验证的推测解码、用历史转移预测下一屏提前推理并延续KV状态，步时延提速1.4-2.4倍且成功率不变。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate on AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) , an interactive live-emulator benchmark comprising 116 parameterized, multi-step tasks across 20 real-world Android applications

held_out_env.quote: Repeatedly selected tasks are instantiated with new parameters (e.g., phone number) each time, so no exact task instance is repeated within a workload.

variance.quote: SR and latency values are reported as mean \pm s.d. across three random seeds.

strong_baselines.quote: We compare PastForward with Vanilla, MobileGPT ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , V-Droid ( Dai et al., 2026 ) , FastV ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and Agent-X ( Chung et al., 2026 ) .

cost_reported.quote: On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

component_ablation.quote: Experience-Guided Adaptive Decoding contributes the largest incremental reduction in action-step latency in Figure 7 , reducing decoding latency by 70.3\text{--}81.6\% across the three backbones.

validator_check.quote: retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward.

evidence_level.quote: During a task execution, the agent interacts online with the running applications, so the resulting screens and transitions come from live application execution rather than a static trace.

S1.quote: PastForward uses computational experience accumulated across task executions to address two major sources of GUI agent latency

S3.quote: As decoding experience accumulates, the retrieval rate increases from 67.0% to 91.1%, while the proposal-acceptance rate follows a similar trend and reaches 59.4% at completion.

F3.quote: However, the opportunities available in practice may vary by workload.

AP5.quote: Under the user-calibrated workload, previously observed VLM output sequences of at least four consecutive tokens cover 64.1% of generated tokens, while GUI transitions recur in 15.1% of action steps.

title_zh: GUI不等于状态：诊断GUI世界模型中的状态混叠
one_line: Shows observation-only GUI world models fail on hidden-state strict pairs and adds a distilled history-based state estimator to frozen WMs; small AndroidWorld gains.
one_line_zh: 揭示仅依赖观测的GUI世界模型在隐藏状态严格配对上失效，为冻结世界模型加入从历史恢复结构化状态的估计器，AndroidWorld小幅提升。

online_eval.quote: predictive-state conditioning increases task success from 58.62% to 60.34% ( +1.72 pp) for GPT-5.4 and from 44.83% to 47.41% ( +2.58 pp) for Qwen3-VL-8B.

held_out_env.quote: We also audit train–evaluation separation and find no duplicate examples or complete trajectories

strong_baselines.quote: Raw History , directly supplying the complete, untruncated interaction history to the WM without state recovery

cost_reported.quote: The state-conditioned Code2World-8B request adds only 5.7% marginal prompt-token overhead, and the unified estimator requires 0.768 s mean generation-and-decoding latency per transition.

component_ablation.quote: reaching 79.38% macro PairCorrect on Code2World-8B and 80.63% on gWorld-8B, compared with 0% under Observation-only conditioning.

validator_check.quote: matches their complete WM-visible observation and next action at a common prediction boundary, and independently validates the resulting semantic outcomes in the real environment.

evidence_level.quote: As shown in Table 4 , predictive-state conditioning increases task success from 58.62% to 60.34% ( +1.72 pp) for GPT-5.4

title_zh: CUA-Sandbox：面向计算机使用智能体强化学习的高效环境
one_line: Separates per-rollout state capsules from shared initialized runtimes with transactional reset/fork; matches Docker success on WebArena, VWA, OSWorld with up to 6.2x throughput.
one_line_zh: 将每条轨迹的可变状态胶囊与共享运行时分离并支持事务式重置/分叉，在WebArena等上成功率不低于Docker，吞吐最高提升6.2倍。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate WebArena, VisualWebArena, and OSWorld using their original task interfaces and evaluators

held_out_env.quote: Post-training uses WebArena, VisualWebArena, and OSWorld, with Qwen3.8-27B as the teacher and Qwen3.5-4B as the student.

strong_baselines.quote: We compare CUA-Sandbox with the conventional Docker-based environment for each benchmark under matched experimental conditions.

budget_matched.quote: Across the two training runs, we match the data and rollout budgets, task sampling procedure, decoding configuration, optimization hyperparameters, reward function, and interaction horizon.

cost_reported.quote: CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.

component_ablation.quote: removing copy-on-write raises create latency from 0.071 to 5.476 s and fork latency from 0.054 to 4.772 s

validator_check.quote: The inference study tests whether changing the execution backend preserves task success

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate CUA-Sandbox on WebArena, VisualWebArena, and OSWorld through paired inference, matched agent post-training, and systems measurements.

S1.quote: we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators.

title_zh: 相关不等于适用：面向个人GUI智能体的经验激活
one_line: Training-free: matches each screen to past personal states to inject one action reference, and gates proactive suggestions by time/scenario; offline AndroidIntent gains.
one_line_zh: 免训练方法：每步按骨干潜空间将当前屏幕匹配到个人历史状态并注入对应动作参考，主动建议按时间与场景门控，离线基准提升。

online_eval.quote: For execution we report action-type accuracy (Type), step success rate (SSR), and the benchmark’s cumulative success rate (CSR).

held_out_env.quote: The chronological first 80% of each user’s records forms the history \mathcal{M}_{u} (15,966 records), and the remaining episodes are evaluation targets excluded from retrieval.

strong_baselines.quote: Within each backbone we compare ExpActivator with the history mechanisms of the benchmark: Recent supplies the latest records, Retrieve the records most similar to the instruction, LLM-UM an offline LLM-written profile, and HIM-Agent a hierarchical intent memory

budget_matched.quote: All methods read the same history and share model revisions and inference settings, so comparisons are paired step by step.

cost_reported.quote: It supplies a single action reference per step and adds 144.6 history tokens, nearly five times fewer than the average baseline

component_ablation.quote: Supplying the trajectory whole, as retrieval-based memories do, yields 18.5% SSR, on par with using no history at all.

evidence_level.quote: For execution we report action-type accuracy (Type), step success rate (SSR), and the benchmark’s cumulative success rate (CSR).

S1.quote: The chronological first 80% of each user’s records forms the history \mathcal{M}_{u} (15,966 records), and the remaining episodes are evaluation targets excluded from retrieval.

S3.quote: When users are grouped into quartiles by the size of their history, ExpActivator outperforms the strongest baseline in every group by more than 27% in relative SSR

AP7.quote: Personalized execution has 775 episodes with 7,915 steps whose instructions are deliberately ambiguous

title_zh: 先探查再行动：通过主动视觉探查提升浏览器智能体
one_line: Replaces static DOM Set-of-Marks with on-demand probes rendering DOM elements to pixels and back, plus evidence-only memory; prompted and distilled agents gain on VisualWebArena.
one_line_zh: 以按需探查替代静态SoM，在DOM与像素间双向对齐并仅保留证据记忆，提示与蒸馏模型在VisualWebArena上均提升。

online_eval.quote: a standard benchmark of 910 multimodal browser-use tasks across three domains (Classifieds, Reddit, Shopping) that stresses image-conditioned reasoning and long-horizon navigation under rigorous functional oracles rather than LLM judges.

held_out_env.quote: We use Gemini-3-Flash to generate diverse browser tasks on random pages from the VWA environment via self-instruction

strong_baselines.quote: Operation-Only Control : Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuned on our cold-start data with all probing steps removed, denoted Operation Cold-Start .

budget_matched.quote: We therefore characterize P2A as additional within-step deliberation rather than a fixed-compute improvement

cost_reported.quote: The 30-step budget counts state-changing browser operations only, while all probe turns are included in the inference accounting.

component_ablation.quote: Active probing itself provides the main gain: even without cross-step observation history, P2A reaches 30.3%, compared with 24.6% for the standard baseline.

validator_check.quote: Throughout the pipeline, Gemini-3-pro Google (2025) serves as the outcome verifier.

evidence_level.quote: on VisualWebArena, for example, it improves Gemini-3-Pro from 54.1% to 61.2% and Qwen3-VL-8B from 24.6% to 32.9%

S1.quote: Standard DOM-SoM , following the community-standard VWA protocol adopted by the majority of prior work, where agents receive a parsed text DOM and a SoM-overlaid screenshot.

S2.quote: Visual Registration handles “ghost elements”—interactable regions (canvas buttons, dynamic overlays) that are missing from the parsed DOM.

S4.quote: Screenshot-Coordinate , where agents operate on raw screenshots via pixel coordinates; we evaluate ScaleCUA Liu et al. (2025b) and Qwen3-VL with zero-shot grounding.

AP4.quote: A judge model verifies task success from the final page state Deng et al. (2023) ; Qi et al. (2024) ; unsuccessful trajectories are discarded.

AP14.quote: At 30% DOM removal, full P2A achieves an 11.1% SR gain over the standard DOM+SoM baseline and a 4.8% SR gain over the no-Registration variant

AP18.quote: It reaches 32.6% at 1.2\times peak retained input context, outperforming standard Full History at substantially lower context cost

title_zh: 只有一次机会：GUI智能体的完全测试时自适应
one_line: Updates a small adapter during deployment by top-K self-distillation on judge-admitted and hindsight-relabeled own episodes, one attempt per task; +3-6 points on web/mobile streams.
one_line_zh: 部署中基于评判模型筛选及事后重标注的自身轨迹，以top-K自蒸馏更新小适配器，每任务仅一次尝试，网页与移动流上提升3-6点。

online_eval.quote: Success rate (%) over the stream under the benchmark’s own evaluator; mean \pm std over three runs per cell.

held_out_env.quote: There is no separate evaluation set: the stream is the evaluation, and every episode counts.

variance.quote: Every method and variant is run three times, and the tables give the mean and standard deviation.

strong_baselines.quote: AWM-online ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and Darwinian Memory (DMS) ( Mi et al., 2026 ) are the two in-setting memory methods of Sec. 2 , adapted from the authors’ released code to our agents and harness

budget_matched.quote: The step budget is 30 on the web streams and 40 on MobileWorld.

cost_reported.quote: Per task, the cost is one judge call, at most two further calls for a judged failure, and at most one gradient step over W episodes, and the adapter is about 0.2% of the backbone.

component_ablation.quote: Hindsight relabeling matters most: the success branch alone keeps about a third of the margin

validator_check.quote: the judge’s precision, the share of the episodes it admitted that the benchmark evaluator scores as successes, averaged over the runs.

evidence_level.quote: On recurring task streams built from WebArena, VisualWebArena and MobileWorld, SOLO improves on the frozen agent with both UI-TARS-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, by three to six points of success rate

S2.quote: The branch is anchored: the window trains only while it holds at least one judged success, so a relabeled prefix is trained only in a window that also holds a judged success

F3.quote: The WebArena stream holds 108 task instances from 27 templates across four sites

AP4.quote: Our reading is that the judge acts as a soft filter rather than as a stand-in for the evaluator.

AP5.quote: The streams are built from benchmark tasks that recur three times, not from user logs, so how often a real deployment repeats an errand, and hence the size of the gain there, is not measured.

title_zh: 行动之前先改变状态：欺骗性界面下Web智能体的前瞻式状态干预
one_line: Runtime defense that detects unauthorized consequences and plans then executes verified browser actions to change consequence-causing web state; highest safe task completion on dark-pattern benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 运行时防御：识别动作的未授权后果，先规划再经验证地执行浏览器操作改变致害网页状态，在暗模式基准上安全完成率最高。

online_eval.quote: Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings

strong_baselines.quote: Within each benchmark, all methods use the same task configurations, base agent, actor model, and base task-step allowance.

budget_matched.quote: all methods use the same task configurations, base agent, actor model, and base task-step allowance

component_ablation.quote: Replacing active intervention with blocking causes the largest degradation, reducing TSR from 86.4% to 51.1% and STC from 85.2% to 50.0%.

code.quote: We provide an anonymized repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Veer-379B containing code and materials for reproducing our experiments.

evidence_level.quote: Veer achieves the highest safe task completion (STC) in all three evaluation settings, reaching 85.2%, 67.6%, and 41.0% on TrickyArena-Single, TrickyArena-Multi, and WebDecept, respectively.

S4.quote: dark-pattern-specific defenses including ICP and Guardrail Cuvin et al. (2026) and DUDE-S2 Zhang et al. (2026) , and general agent-safety defenses including Spotlighting Hines et al. (2024) , VIGIL Lin et al. (2026) , and SafePred

F3.quote: SafePred attains a higher TSR of 58.1%, but its 38.1% DPSR reduces STC to 38.7%. The lower TSR of Veer motivates examining task feasibility.

AP20.quote: Our experiments use established research benchmarks and controlled Web environments and do not involve human subjects
